title: Grateful Dead Live at Euphoria Ballroom on 1970-07-16

ai_review.summary: Crisp soundboard capture of a legendary Janis‑and‑Dead show highlighted by a jaw‑dropping Lovelight jam.
ai_review.review: The recording delivers clear, crisp sound (with a bit of tape hiss) from the rare Jan Joplin appearance with the Dead, preserving an electric energy that fans describe as “sexy” and “raunchy.”  The performance shines on the Lovelight duet between Janis and Pigpen, with additional early gems like Candyman and China/Rider, making this a must‑listen for any Deadhead.

ai_rating.rationale: Overwhelmingly positive reviews (average 4.8/5) praise both the historic performance and the generally good soundboard quality, with only minor hiss noted.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Crisp and clear overall; some reviewers note a slight tape hiss. One comment mentions a direct cassette transfer, indicating a solid but not flawless sound source.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The set bursts with energy, especially the Lovelight duet between Janis and Pigpen. Early tracks like Candyman and China/Rider keep the momentum high, and the overall vibe reflects the post‑Festival Express excitement.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Garcia’s guitar is repeatedly called “sexy” and praised for his interplay with Janis during Lovelight.
